title: POST /preview has no route-level regression coverage
reasoning: The reviewed route crosses authentication, Gmail service integration, response serialization, configured-vs-unconfigured behavior, and broad exception handling, but no linked tests were provided and repository search found only NewsletterService unit coverage, not API coverage for POST /api/newsletters/preview. A change to the dependency wiring, response shape, status/count/articles mapping, or error path could regress without failing tests.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI route tests that override authentication/settings and monkeypatch NewsletterService to cover configured success, unconfigured error, service exception, and auth rejection if existing auth tests do not already cover route dependencies.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included feature metadata lists no tests, and the existing newsletter tests exercise NewsletterService parsing/fetch behavior rather than the preview_newsletters route contract.
suggestedRegressionTest: Use TestClient against /api/newsletters/preview with dependency overrides or monkeypatched NewsletterService: assert a successful fetch returns status ok with count and serialized articles, an unconfigured service returns status error, and a raised service exception returns the expected PreviewResponse error body.
minimumFixScope: Add route-level tests only; no production code change is required unless tests expose an actual route contract defect.
